battle.name: 青海之戰
battle.brief: 青海戰線的戰役自咸亨元年（670）秋開打：吐蕃贊普祿東贊率二十萬眾自青海道東下，唐以宗室李敬玄為安西道行軍大總管，輕進至青海湖西南，兵潰於大非川，士卒死傷十之六七，李敬玄被俘；到儀鳳三年（678）薛仁貴率軍反攻青海、吐蕃請和，這條戰線才收束。卡面羅馬重步兵屬前1世紀的裝備，與本役相隔近千年，並未出現在戰場上；同期唐軍用直刃刀與長槊，吐蕃用藏式長刀與長矛。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 此役交戰雙方是唐與吐蕃。唐朝方面是關隴軍府帝國，此時以隴右道、涼州與河州一線的邊軍為骨幹，另在關中、中原、江淮一帶廣募兵員，選取臂力過人、弓馬嫻熟者編入新軍，隨軍配器械、輜重與工匠。前線經營自河源縣、鄯州直到涼州城，東接隴右軍鎮，糧秣仰賴涼州、甘肅諸縣的屯田與軍倉。唐廷以宗室李敬玄為安西道行軍大總管，節制青海道諸軍，薛仁貴、郭待封為副總管，節制權與監軍互相牽制。吐蕃方面是高原政權，贊普祿東贊親領大軍，以吐蕃本部騎兵為主力，裹脅吐谷渾故地的部眾與隨軍工匠，駐營於青海湖周邊草場，憑騎兵機動與輕裝掠糧作戰。戰場在青海湖及其以南的吐谷渾故境，正當唐通往西域的青海道要衝；雙方在此爭的並非城池，而是青海道本身的控制權，以及這條路後面接通西域的樞紐。
countriesEn: The two parties in this campaign were the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan Empire. On the Tang side stood a centralised frontier state whose field armies came chiefly from the Longyou circuit and the garrisons of Liangzhou and Hezhou, supplemented by recruits raised across Guanzhong, the Central Plain and the Jianghuai region, where men of exceptional strength and practiced archery and horsemanship were selected into newly formed units that marched with their own weapons, transport animals and craftsmen. The forward line ran from Hayuan county and Shanzhou to the fortress of Liangzhou, and its grain came from the garrison farms and depot stores of Liangzhou and Gansu. The Tang court appointed the imperial clansman Li Jingxuan as Anxi Circuit Army Grand Commander to direct the Qinghai corridor, with Xue Rengui and Guo Daifeng as deputy commanders, so that command and oversight were bound to check one another. Opposite them was the Tibetan plateau state: under the tsapgyal, Gar Trinring himself led a great host whose core was Tibetan cavalry, reinforced by the peoples of the former Tuyuhun country and by craftsmen travelling with the army, whose camps stood on the grazing grounds around Qinghai Lake. The battlefield was the lake and the old Tuyuhun country to the south of it, directly astride the Qinghai road by which the Tang reached their western territories. What the two sides fought over was not a walled city but control of that corridor, and of the junction that led from it to the Western Regions.
people: 唐高宗李治在咸亨元年（670）以宗室領軍，李敬玄（李道興）出身宗室、久歷邊鎮，奉命為安西道行軍大總管，統兵赴青海；他不待援軍集結，也不採副總管薛仁貴之議，徑自推進，兵敗後被吐蕃俘虜。薛仁貴為唐初名將，時任副總管，力主擇勢再戰，卻因部將郭待封違令掠取吐蕃牧馬、唐軍失馬而陷無馬可騎之絕地，屢戰屢敗，其後被貶為庶人，數年後復出，卒於永淳元年。吐蕃方面由贊普祿東贊親率大軍，主持東征。隨軍還有各級將校、從全國募來的勇力之士與工匠。前線之外，主持募兵與籌措軍資的官員，與主張持重、避免再以重兵深入高原者，構成本役另一層角力。十四年後，燕然都護王孝傑率兵再入青海，擊破吐蕃，收復西域四鎮，是此役未竟的後續，也由唐蕃兩方面的記錄共同列入。
peopleEn: The Tang emperor Gaozong, Li Zhi, entrusted the command in the third year of Xianheng to a member of the imperial clan. Li Jingxuan, also known as Li Daoxing, was a long-serving frontier officer who was appointed Anxi Circuit Army Grand Commander and led the army into Qinghai; he pressed forward before his reinforcements had assembled and against the advice of his deputy Xue Rengui, was defeated and was taken prisoner by the Tibetans. Xue Rengui, one of the famous commanders of the early Tang, served as deputy commander and argued for choosing the right moment for a fresh engagement, but the army lost its horses when the deputy Guo Daifeng disobeyed orders and seized Tibetan pastured mounts, and after repeated defeats Xue was demoted to commoner status; he was later recalled to service and died in the first year of Yongchun. On the Tibetan side the tsapgyal Gar Trinring led the host in person and directed the eastern campaign. Around them were the subordinate generals of the army, the strong-armed volunteers recruited from across the interior and the craftsmen travelling with the column. Beyond the front, the officials who handled the recruiting and the supply of funds contended with those who urged caution and refused any further commitment of heavy troops to the plateau. Fourteen years later the Yanran Protector, Wang Xiaojie, marched back into Qinghai, defeated the Tibetans and recovered the four garrisons of the Western Regions; that unfinished sequel belongs to this campaign as much as to theirs, and is recorded on both sides.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬重步兵（Legionary）：約公元前1世紀的羅馬軍團重裝步兵，分段鎧甲（甲片分肩、胸、腰三段，以便屈身）配大盾，長方盾面覆皮甲與木芯，兩手持握，短劍與兩支投槊為副武器。羅馬人自己也說，重步兵的戰力不靠裝備，而靠兵源補充與補給線——嚴整的野營制度、每日十五羅里的行程、與基地之間的糧道，都是這支部隊能持續作戰的前提。這一點必須先說清楚：這支部隊並沒有出現在青海，它比本役早近千年，屬地中海世界的兵制，與唐代募兵、府兵與蕃兵分屬不同制度世代。它的價值在於標示一種做法的源頭：用重裝步兵去頂住對手的騎兵衝鋒，靠盾牆、靠陣形、靠後方不斷補上來的補充兵員，把騎兵的衝擊吃掉。唐軍在青海道上其實用的是同一套邏輯的另一種版本：步卒列陣以長槊與大盾抵擋吐蕃騎兵的衝撞，鎧甲用明光鎧、步人甲一類的分段鐵甲，後方靠涼州、河源一線的屯田與糧倉維持；而真正讓唐軍崩潰的，不是披甲不夠，而是糧草斷絕、馬匹失掉、步騎在無後援狀態下耗盡。同期吐蕃步兵以藏式長刀、長矛與投槊為近戰兵器，弓箭與短弓為主，披皮甲並有部分鎖子甲，作營隨帶氈帳與犛牛馱載物資。刀劍在此不是主要殺傷手段，而是把對方步卒或騎兵逼下坐騎的器械。
kitsEn: The card weapon is the Roman legionary, the heavy infantry of the Roman army as it stood at about the first century BC: segmented armour, the plates divided at the shoulder, chest and waist so that the wearer could bend, and a large shield, the scutum, faced with hide over a wooden core, carried with two hands, with a short sword and a pair of javelins as secondary weapons. The Romans themselves held that the strength of the heavy infantry lay not in the equipment but in the replenishment of men and in the supply line: the strict camp routine of the legion, the day's march of fifteen Roman miles, and the grain road back to the base were the conditions that let that body keep fighting. That must be said plainly: no such troops were at Qinghai. They stand nearly a thousand years before the campaign and belong to the military system of the Mediterranean world, a different institutional generation from the Tang recruited levies, the fubing and the Tibetan levies. The value of the card is as the origin point of a method: using heavy infantry to absorb a cavalry charge, relying on the shield wall, on the formation and on replacements coming up from the rear to eat the impact of horsemen. What the Tang actually used on the Qinghai road was the same logic in another version: infantry drawn up with long spears and large shields against the impact of Tibetan horse, armour of the ming-guang and bu-ren types, the segmented iron plates, and behind them the farms and granaries of the Liangzhou and Heyuan line. What actually broke the Tang army was not a shortage of armour but the end of the grain, the loss of the horses and the exhaustion of infantry and cavalry with no reinforcement. Tibetan soldiers fought with long knives of Tibetan type, long spears and javelins, using the bow and the short bow, wearing hide armour with some mail, and carrying felt tents and pack yaks. On the field the sword was not chiefly a tool for cutting men down but a means of knocking a foot soldier or a rider out of the saddle.
tactics: 戰術上，吐蕃把高原騎兵的機動發揮到極致：主力以縱隊沿青海湖南岸草場推進，前鋒不急於接戰，先以輕騎切斷唐軍水源與柴草，逼唐軍在無水草之地作戰；遇戰即以密集騎兵衝擊唐軍陣腳，擊潰之後不深追，轉而搜掠糧秣與牲畜，消耗唐軍補給。唐軍的部署則處處受制於地形與時序：李敬玄輕進，與援軍相隔數百里，未設補給點，也不安排傷兵後送；接戰前只遣少量精騎出挑，後援未至，士氣已挫，一觸即潰。退保大非川後，部將郭待封不聽將令，擅自帶人掠取吐蕃牧馬，唐軍賴以機動的馬匹大批走失，全軍陷於步行挨打的境地；軍中乏食，士卒掘地取草，甚至殺馬充飢，軍心崩解。薛仁貴在大非川再接戰，見勢不可為，仍整軍攻擊，結果全軍潰散，僅以數百騎突圍而還。整場戰役的教訓，是高原野戰的勝負不在單挑，而在誰能先把水源與草場握在手裡、把戰馬的飼料籌措充足。
tacticsEn: In tactical terms the Tibetans pushed the mobility of plateau cavalry to its limit. The main body moved down the grassland along the southern shore of Qinghai Lake in column; the vanguard was in no hurry to engage, and light cavalry were sent ahead to cut the Tang water supply and firewood, forcing the Tang army to fight where there was neither water nor grass. When a battle did come, massed riders charged the Tang line to break it, and once the line collapsed they did not pursue deeply but turned to seizing grain and livestock, exhausting the Tang supplies. The Tang deployment was constrained at every point by terrain and timing. Li Jingxuan pressed forward with his reinforcements several hundred li away, established no supply points and arranged no route for the wounded back. Before contact he sent out only a few picked riders; the supports had not arrived, morale had already been shaken, and the advance fell apart at the first impact. After the army took refuge at Dafeichuan, the deputy Guo Daifeng disregarded his orders and took men off to seize Tibetan pastured horses; the mounts on which the army depended for mobility were lost in large numbers, and the troops were left fighting on foot while the enemy rode. Food ran short, the soldiers dug for grass to eat and even killed horses for meat, and the morale of the army collapsed. Xue Rengui engaged again at Dafeichuan, saw that the situation was hopeless, and attacked in any case; the army was routed and he escaped with a few hundred riders. The lesson of the whole campaign was that a battle on the plateau was not settled by single combat but by whoever could hold the water and the pasture and keep the horses supplied with fodder.
data: 可查證的數字有限，但幾個大數字足以說明規模。吐蕃方面，舊唐書、新唐書與資治通鑑一致記載祿東贊此次東征領兵二十萬；唐軍方面，史料只說是從全國募兵而成，總數沒有留下可靠記載，推想當在數萬之眾，就大非川再戰的兵力和傷亡比例反推，最多十萬上下。損失方面，記青海一役唐軍士卒死傷「十六七」，即十人之中六、七人不能回；記大非川再戰唐兵死者「十之七八」，兩戰相加，唐軍在青海道上損失了全部兵力的四分之三以上。時間上，戰役自咸亨元年（670）秋開打，到同年冬第二場敗仗收場，前後約三個月；青海道西段的爭奪此後仍未了結，直到儀鳳三年（678）薛仁貴率軍反攻青海、吐蕃大敗請和，這條戰線才告收束。地理上，唐代記載西域距長安約四千里，行程以青海道與河西走廊串成；青海湖海拔約三千一百九十六公尺，東西長約一百零五公里、南北寬約六十三公里，環湖一周約三百公里，四月至八月可行軍，九月之後風雪封山，大軍難以越嶺。馬匹的飼料是比兵器更硬的限制：青海湖周邊草場容量有限，一旦二十萬眾與數萬唐軍同時壓上同一片草場，馬就開始餓。
dataEn: Reliable figures are scarce, but a few large ones tell the scale. On the Tibetan side the Old and New Tang histories and the Comprehensive Mirror to the Aid of Government all record that Gar Trinring led 200,000 men east on this campaign. On the Tang side the sources say only that the army was raised by recruiting across the empire and give no dependable total; judging from the strength engaged and the casualty rate in the second battle at Dafeichuan, it was at most something in the order of 100,000. In losses, the records state that in the battle at Qinghai the Tang dead and wounded numbered six or seven in every ten, and that at Dafeichuan seven or eight in every ten of the Tang soldiers fell; taken together, the two defeats destroyed more than three quarters of the Tang force on the Qinghai road. In time, the campaign opened in the third month of the third year of Xianheng and ended with the second defeat in the eleventh month of the same year, roughly eight months from start to finish. In distance, Tang records put the Western Regions about 4,000 li from the capital, a journey strung together by the Qinghai road and the Hexi Corridor. Qinghai Lake lies at about 3,196 metres above sea level, is roughly 105 kilometres long from east to west and 63 kilometres wide from north to south, and takes about 300 kilometres to go around; from April to August a force can move through the region, and from September the passes are closed by wind and snow. Fodder for the horses was a harder constraint than any weapon: the grazing grounds around the lake have a limited carrying capacity, and once 200,000 Tibetans and several tens of thousands of Tang soldiers pressed onto the same pasture, the horses began to starve.
cause: 起火點在唐蕃對青海道的爭奪。吐谷渾原是唐的藩屬，其地在青海湖一帶，扼住唐通往西域四鎮的青海道；咸亨元年（670年），吐蕃攻陷西域十八州，唐被迫罷安西四鎮、遷安西百姓入關，東西商路與軍援通道就此中斷。吐谷渾餘部向唐請兵，內附成為唐的藩屬，可唐廷既已無力西顧，邊防實際退到河湟一線。咸亨元年之後，唐遣使與吐蕃議和、互贈金帛，兩度短暫緩和；但和議只解決儀節，沒有解決牧場、水源與通道的歸屬。咸亨元年（670），祿東贊傾全族之力東下，名義是收復吐谷渾舊地，實際是要打通唐與西域之間最後一段路，扼住唐軍再入西域的咽喉。唐廷的應對也透露心態：既要雪前恥，又想避免重兵深入與朝廷傾力，於是以宗室領兵、全國募勇的方式組建遠征軍，期許以新軍的銳氣與良將的經驗，把青海道重新握回手中。於是兩個政權在青海湖邊，以各自都承受不起失敗的理由，開始了一場誰都消耗不起的對撞。
causeEn: The spark was the contest over the Qinghai road. Tuyuhun, originally a vassal of the Tang, held the country around Qinghai Lake and stood astride the corridor by which the Tang reached the four garrisons of the Western Regions. In the first year of Xianheng, 670, the Tibetans seized the eighteen prefectures of the Western Regions, and the Tang were obliged to abolish the four garrisons of Anxi and move the people of Anxi inside the passes; the trade route and the line of military reinforcement were cut. The surviving Tuyuhun asked to be sheltered and became a client of the Tang, but the court had no strength to look west, and the frontier in practice fell back to the River Huang and the Hehuang line. After that first year the Tang sent envoys to negotiate with the Tibetans and exchanged gold and silk, and for a while the two sides were at peace; but the settlement settled only ceremonial matters, not the ownership of pasture, water and roads. In the third year of Xianheng Gar Trinring moved east with the strength of the whole state. Nominally he was recovering the old Tuyuhun country; in substance he wanted to open the last stretch of the road between the Tang and the Western Regions and to hold the throat through which Tang armies would have to pass. The Tang response reveals the state of mind of the court: it wanted to wipe out the earlier defeat and yet to avoid committing heavy troops and exhausting the treasury, so it built a distant expedition with a clansman in command and recruits drawn from the whole empire, hoping that the vigour of new troops and the experience of good generals would bring the Qinghai road back into Tang hands. And so two states collided beside Qinghai Lake, each for reasons it could not afford to lose, in a contest neither could afford.
impact: 青海之戰的後果，首先落在唐的西域經營上。此役之後，唐朝放棄主動西進的念頭，改以屯田積粟、築城守塞、待敵自耗的辦法處理西域：在西州、龜茲一帶設屯，遣官員管領，軍糧就地生產，減少長途轉運之苦，政策延續到武周時期，後來又成為唐代邊鎮屯田的樣板。吐蕃則藉此役盡收吐谷渾故地，屏障立在青海湖與日月山一帶，唐蕃邊界由河湟推到青海，雙方在邊境線上互相羈縻。此役後兩年，文成公主在吐蕃去世，唐蕃以和親維繫的象徵失效；又十餘年，到長安三年（692年），王孝傑率兵在青海一帶大破吐蕃，吐谷渾故地一度重回唐手，唐復置安西四鎮並設安西都護府，西域經商重新打通。從更長的視角看，青海之戰是唐蕃在西域長期角力的起點：它開啟了以屯田、固守、待時為主的唐朝西域國策，也開啟了吐蕃南下青海、以騎兵與牧地補給支撐遠征的傳統，直到唐蕃在長安會盟（821年）之後，才以和約方式把這一輪角力收束。
impactEn: The consequences of the battle at Qinghai fell first on the Tang position in the Western Regions. After it the Tang abandoned the idea of carrying the war west and switched to a policy of growing grain in garrison farms, building forts and passes and waiting for the enemy to exhaust himself: farms were established around Xizhou and Qiuci with officials in charge, so that military grain was produced on the spot instead of being dragged over long distances. The policy continued into the Wu Zhou period and later became a model for Tang frontier farming. The Tibetans, for their part, took the whole of the old Tuyuhun country, set the frontier barrier around Qinghai Lake and the Riyue Mountains, and pushed the Tang-Tibetan border from the River Huang out to the lake, with the two states tethering each other along the line. Two years after the battle the Princess Wencheng died in Tibet, and the symbol by which the relationship had been held together through marriage failed. A little over a decade afterwards, in the third year of Chang'an, 692, Wang Xiaojie defeated the Tibetans in the Qinghai region, the old Tuyuhun country returned to Tang hands for a time, the four garrisons of Anxi were restored and a Protectorate of the Western Regions was set up, reopening the western trade road. In the longer view, the battle at Qinghai is the opening move of the long contest between Tang and Tibet in the Western Regions: it began the Tang policy of farming, holding and waiting, and it began the Tibetan practice of campaigning south into Qinghai on the strength of cavalry and pasture supplies, a rivalry that was not closed off by treaty until the Chanyuan alliance of 821.
result: 結果是唐軍慘敗、吐蕃全勝。青海一役，李敬玄所部潰散於大非川，他本人被吐蕃生擒，士卒十成之中死傷六、七成；薛仁貴、郭待封收攏殘兵再戰，又在同一片草場上大敗，士卒死者十之七八，軍中斷糧，掘地取草、殺馬充飢。薛仁貴因此被貶為庶人，數年後才復用，卒於永淳元年；李敬玄在吐蕃軍中為上賓，因是唐室宗親而未被加害，其後得以返唐。吐蕃沒有乘勝追入河湟：薛仁貴等退守涼州、河源一線，唐軍守住了青海湖以東的門戶，吐蕃得了青海湖以西與吐谷渾故地，卻沒有多得一座關隘與一座城。於是此役的直接結果是：吐谷渾作為獨立政權從此消失，青海道西段盡歸吐蕃，唐朝在西域的四鎮要到十四年後才由王孝傑收復；而軍事勝負的真正後果，則是把唐蕃之間長達百年的青海與西域爭端正式拉開序幕。此後八年，青海道西段一直在吐蕃手中，直到儀鳳三年（678）薛仁貴率軍反攻青海，斬獲數萬、收牛羊數萬頭，吐蕃遣使請和，唐蕃才在青海一線重新議和；本卡所標的678年，正是這條戰線收束的年份。
resultEn: The result was a crushing Tang defeat and a complete Tibetan victory. In the battle at Qinghai the army of Li Jingxuan broke up at Dafeichuan, he himself was taken alive by the Tibetans, and between six and seven Tang soldiers in every ten were killed or wounded; Xue Rengui and Guo Daifeng gathered the remnants and fought again, were beaten a second time on the same ground, and lost seven or eight in ten of the men, with food running out, the soldiers digging for grass and killing horses to eat. Xue Rengui was demoted to commoner status for it, was recalled to service some years later and died in the first year of Yongchun. Li Jingxuan was treated as an honoured guest in Tibetan hands; because he was a clansman of the Tang royal house he was not harmed, and he was eventually allowed to return. The Tibetans did not press on into the River Huang valley after the victory. Xue Rengui and the survivors held the line at Liangzhou and Hayuan, and the Tang kept the gateway east of Qinghai Lake. The Tibetans gained the lake and the old Tuyuhun country west of it, but not a single pass and not a single city. The direct outcome of the campaign was therefore this: Tuyuhun ceased to exist as an independent polity, the western half of the Qinghai road passed entirely to the Tibetans, and the four Tang garrisons in the Western Regions were not recovered until fourteen years later, by Wang Xiaojie. The deeper military outcome was to open in earnest a century of rivalry between Tang and Tibet over Qinghai and the Western Regions.
